title: Is This MSFS Mission Pack Worth It? | 100 Years of Lufthansa A320 Edition
description:
The weekly Microsoft Flight Simulator Marketplace update is here, and this time we are diving deep into a major milestone release: the "100 Years of Lufthansa – A320 Edition" mission pack by Perfect Flight.

Designed natively for the high-fidelity iniBuilds Airbus A320neo (A320neo V2), this package introduces 12 ultra-realistic, highly structured IFR commercial airline missions across Europe. If you have been looking for an immersive way to fly the line, this pack tests your skills along iconic routes reaching from the busy Rhine-Main hub out to Scandinavia, the scenic Iberian Coast, and the technically demanding terrain of Innsbruck and Nice.

Aside from the structured mission engine, the pack includes the official commemorative Lufthansa Centennial deep-navy livery. In this video, we break down exactly what you get inside the mission browser, check out its compatibility with your favorite third-party navigation tools, and analyze whether it's worth the marketplace purchase.

✈️ What do you think? Are you planning to pick up this official mission pack from the Marketplace, or will you stick to downloading free liveries from community sites like Flightsim.to? Let me know your thoughts in the comment section below!

Don't forget to like, subscribe for weekly simulator updates, and clear skies on your next departure!
